moments.selftext: Let this sink in: In Israel, as part of an election campaign, a cabinet minister issues an AI video showing how his policies starve Palestinians in jail. So forced starvation is not just something to brag about - it's an election platform. In other news: The US is on the cusp of essentially merging its intelligence operations with that of Israel...
